messages.subject: For Sheikh Saoud Salem Al-Sabah | Sovereign investment, government relations and global portfolio strategy
messages.body:
Dear Kuwait Investment Authority Team,

Please place this executive introduction before H.E. Sheikh Saoud Salem Abdulaziz Al-Sabah, Managing Director.

KIA's global portfolio strategy operates across diverse markets where government relationships, institutional partnerships and disciplined stakeholder execution matter to long-term value creation. That environment aligns strongly with my experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement across complex regulated environments.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, strategic partnerships and emerging-market stakeholder strategy might support KIA's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Kuwait Investment Authority.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
